measurement_basis.lineup_note: Owner sketch: red = proposed car rows, yellow = motorcycle parcel, green = shared access. The sketch guides row placement; cumulative ruler labels do not replace the supplied metre lengths. Live slot colours continue to mean availability. Some marked perimeter strokes cannot be filled without blocking full-size access frontages.
measurement_basis.boundary_note: Numbers 1–6 match the owner sketch: right 18.42m, lower-right 12.04m, notch 2.60m, lower diagonal 20.18m, long left diagonal 33.37m and top 49.26m. Upper pink junction: 3.36m; lower pink segment is C3, 2.60m. The earlier 3.00m value was corrected by the owner and is not used. The shared motorcycle end is 8.80m. The short NW return is estimated at 4.66m from the image; its length and all boundary bearings need site confirmation. This corrected outline supersedes the earlier eight-consecutive-edge interpretation.
measurement_basis.note: Proposed layout at one scale: 8 drawing units = 1 metre. Motorcycle dimensions are owner-reported. Car edges 1–6 follow the owner-numbered sketch. The shared motorcycle end is included; the short NW return and all bearings are estimated, not surveyed. Earlier cumulative map-ruler labels have been removed.
measurement_basis.motorcycle_proposal: 84 compact bays: 3 rows × 28, each 1.00 × 2.00 m. Two 1.20 m internal aisles, a 2.56 m connecting end aisle, 0.40 m end margin and 0.20 m side margins. Narrow aisles are a walk/push proposal for compact motorcycles and scooters; actual vehicle sizes and manoeuvring must be checked.
measurement_basis.car_proposal: 45 full-size independent proposed bays: 18 north-perimeter regular bays numbered C-01–C-18, 15 in interior row A, eight in interior row B and four in the south row. All 45 car bays are regular 2.50 × 5.00 m bays. The prototype has no PWD designation or accessibility eligibility workflow. Internal access frontages are 4.50 m, a tight concept allowance requiring actual turning checks, not a certified standard aisle. No tandem bays are used. This is not a maximum-capacity or vehicle swept-path certification. All 55 car records remain; C-46–C-55 have no measured position. The 45-position count is conditional on the reconstructed outline and site validation.

vehicle_measurements.note: Owner-measured maximum dimensions. Car width is body-only; mirrors, wheelbase, steering lock and turning envelope are not measured. These figures do not replace bay dimensions.

measurement_basis.circulation_note: Opposing rows share 4.50 m internal aisles. The western passage connects the lower aisle. Every frontage connects geometrically to the shared approach through a nominal 3.06 m clear-envelope grid. Connectivity is not a steering or swept-path test. The 4.50 m aisle choice, mirrors, wheelbase, turning lock, end manoeuvres, accessibility and the estimated NW boundary require campus validation before marking bays.

standards.label: Car bay
standards.basis: Philippine NBCP perpendicular/diagonal bay reference. The proposed 4.50 m internal aisle is a tight concept allowance, not a legal-standard or turning-clearance claim; validate it using the actual vehicles.
standards.source: National Building Code IRR, Rule VII, Section 707(4)(b), Pasig government copy, p. 100

standards.label: Parallel car bay
standards.basis: Philippine NBCP parallel bay reference. Proposed 3.60 m access frontage and end manoeuvres need actual vehicle checks.
standards.source: DPWH Department Order 56, series of 2016, Annex A, parking dimensions

standards.label: Compact motorcycle bay
standards.basis: Compact design reference from UK council guidance, not a Philippine legal minimum or suitable for every motorcycle. A larger vehicle/bay requirement reduces the proposed count.
standards.source: North Tyneside Council, Transport and Highways SPD 2022, Appendix E

capacity_review.note: The target is not reduced. Forty-five independent positions have a conditional full-size geometric proposal. This is a found arrangement, not a proven maximum. Validate boundary estimates and tight circulation on site. The remaining ten inventory codes have no proposed physical position.

measurement_basis.pathway_note: The shared road follows the existing gate and diagonal route. Its width is 3.06 m in total, separate from the motorcycle parcel; arrows indicate alternating entry/exit, not two simultaneous car lanes. Internal parking aisles have been rearranged. Physical gate and turning clearances remain subject to campus review.
